messages:
sara: Quick heads-upwe shipped an `exports` tweak and a couple onboarding samples started failing on edge runtimes. Error is `TypeError: RedwoodClient is not a constructor` when deployed to Vercel Edge.

tom: Oof. Which entry did the bundler pick for SSR?

sara: package.json has conditionals: `import: ./dist/index.mjs`, `require: ./dist/index.cjs`. Locally Node ESM imports fine, but the SSR bundler inlines the CJS file into the edge bundle.

yuki: If the published CJS is a legacy shim (default-only) then named imports like `import { RedwoodClient }` will be undefined at runtime. That matches the error.

vikram: We've also seen a secondary issue: TypeScript defs still show named exports, so VSCode suggests the right shapes but the runtime differs  super confusing for users.

sara: Also noticed a dynamic `import('./retry')` in auth middleware. On edge SSR bundling that dynamic import sometimes becomes a separate chunk that isn't available at runtime  causing `createAuthClient` to be undefined.

tom: Short-term fixes we applied for samples: force resolver to prefer ESM for SSR builds (`resolve.mainFields = ['module','browser','main']`) and alias `@redwood/inference` -> `@redwood/inference/dist/index.mjs` for edge bundles. Not great but unblocks customers.

yuki: Long-term action items: remove legacy CJS shim and ensure CJS build preserves named exports; add explicit subpath exports like `./edge` -> `./dist/index.mjs`; add an ESM compatibility re-export wrapper; and align d.ts with runtime shapes.

vikram: Also add publish-time CI checks: (1) run `node -e "console.log(require('@redwood/inference'))"` and assert `RedwoodClient` exists, (2) run a Node ESM process to `import('@redwood/inference')` and assert named exports, (3) run a tiny tsserver check to ensure types reflect exported shapes.

sara: I'll open a ticket with the repro and add infra-samples/edge-exports-repro.

ci-bot: created issue RED-DEVEX-4622 - "exports: restore runtime/type parity and edge SSR compatibility" (assigned to tom)

tom: I'll prepare the patch to remove the shim and add `./edge` subpath. I'll also add a note in CHANGELOG + DevEx guide with recommended bundler configs for Rollup/Vite/Next.

yuki: One more note: avoid critical runtime lazy dynamic imports for auth/retry middleware unless we can guarantee bundlers inline them for SSR. Prefer static imports or documented bundler hints.

vikram: Agreed. Prioritize the CI publish checks so this doesn't ship again.

sara: Thanks team  let's track in the issue.
